about: The renderer-completion feature checklist (MJXOFF-296). One row per user-visible feature per format, four stage owners each, an owning ticket or an out-of-scope decision. Checked by xtask/tests/feature_checklist.rs.

stages.model: the crate and reader API that reads the feature out of the file
stages.layout: the box model that places it
stages.scene: the companion that resolves its handles into display-list paint
stages.decode: the image decoder that turns picture bytes into pixels; carried only by rows that draw a picture

stage_owner_spellings.none: no crate exists yet; created_by names the ticket that creates it
stage_owner_spellings.not-applicable: the stage has no part in this feature; why says so

audit_state.gap: the 2026-09-15 audits found this missing or wrong
audit_state.working: the audits found the stages present; render-tier proof on the corporate fixture belongs to the acceptance ticket
